subject: Windows build failing on default template arg

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Windows build failing on default template arg
parts:
All of our tests pass on my Mac:

> make clean; make test-all

From Jenkins' report, it looks like a compiler config
issue on Windows:

src/stan/prob/distributions_normal.hpp:53:33: error: default
template arguments may not be used in function templates without
-std=c++0x or -std=gnu++0x

Line 53 is the last line of:

template <bool propto = false,
typename T_y, typename T_loc, typename T_scale,
class Policy = policy<> >
inline typename promote_args<T_y,T_loc,T_scale>::type
normal_log(const T_y& y, const T_loc& mu, const T_scale& sigma,
const Policy& = Policy()) {

- Bob

P.S. This continuous build and test stuff is awesome, Daniel.
I'd never used it on a project before. I forgot to check
in the new meta/convert file.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Windows build failing on default template arg
parts:
And yes, it passes on my mac too. Not with my version of g++, though.
I have g++ 4.2, which doesn't support the default function templates
arguments. It is supported starting with g++ 4.3.

The following link shows support for C++0x/C++11x in GCC:
http://gcc.gnu.org/projects/cxx0x.html
